newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

In response to a question, Commission spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said the August 30 deadline set for a decision on whether to organise genetically modified corn applied to the Council not the Commission.
He said the three committees that are considering the question will meet next week. The Commission will make a decision after it gets their opinions.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/813: Commission approves four grants worth 1.43 European currency units to support humanitarian assistance in Chad, Montserrat, Costa Rica and Thailand.
- Memo/96/79: Calendar for the week September 2-7 1996.
- Memo/96/80: Relations between the EU and Kazakhstan.
- Memo/96/81: Relations between the EU and Kyrghystan.
- Memo/96/82: Relations between the EU and Mongolia.
- Eurostat news release 52/96: EU annual inflation figures for July.
